about_the_game:
Ekholux™ — A VR Shock Unlike Anything You've Experienced

Step into a world fractured by meaning, where the puzzle isn't just mechanical—it's embedded in your flesh.

Unlock sound-reactive puzzles. Shatter obstacles with motion. Race across gravity-defying rails in a sensory gauntlet that tests your reflexes and redefines immersion.

Crafted by internationally awarded VR artist Hsin-Chien Huang, Ekholux™ fuses the cerebral thrill of escape-room logic with the visceral rush of extreme movement—engineered for those who crave a new kind of full-body storytelling.

Puzzle Mode

In a realm twisted by echoes, sound isn't just a clue—it's the language reality runs on.Harness your Ekho Capsule to activate dormant systems, reveal hidden paths, and recover fractured memories buried deep within corrupted architecture. This isn't just a puzzle—it's a confrontation with the remnants of human consciousness.

Extreme Sport Mode

After every puzzle sequence, the tempo spikes. You're propelled into a velocity-fueled run through high-speed rails, carving across zero-gravity curves—every twist synced to the pulse of electronic sound. Blending the raw thrill of parkour, skateboarding, and snowboarding, this is more than motion—it's an otherworldly adrenaline surge. No gear. No brakes. Just your body, your rhythm, your courage.

Demo Content

  • English language only

  • Core gameplay only (Puzzle Mode and Extreme Sport Mode)

  • Includes puzzle and race sections only from Chapter 0

  • From the lobby, you can directly choose which mode to play (Puzzle or Race)

Full Game Will Include

  • Complete chapter experiences with both puzzle and race modes fully integrated

  • Multiple language options

  • Achievement system

  • Control scheme adjustments

  • Full system settings (volume, graphics, etc.)

  • Save/load functionality

  • Spawn point selection and teleportation

  • Difficulty settings

  • Power-up abilities

  • Game content customization

About Full Release Timeline

Playable Demo｜August 2025
Full Release｜2026

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit) / Windows 11 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 / AMD FX 8350 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1070, RTX 2060, AMD Radeon RX 5600 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 128 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR. Meta headsets and Meta Quest 2 / Quest 3 / Quest Pro controllers only.

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
